# Snowy hilltop: a 9-sided slab, its top poked and lifted into a low mound, stone sides, a rocky underside. Up Z.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Top --vertices 9 --radius 3.3 --depth 0.5 --location 0 0 -0.25
material new Snow --base-color 0.745 0.898 0.882
material new Stone --base-color 0.235 0.263 0.282 --no-slot
material slot add
active Top
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
material assign Stone
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
poke
select vert where "abs(pos.x) < 0.01 && abs(pos.y) < 0.01 && pos.z > 0"
translate 0 0 0.25
mode object
add mesh cone --name Under --vertices 9 --radius1 0.7 --radius2 3.2 --depth 2.0 --location 0 0 -1.5
material assign Stone
active Under
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -0.5"
randomize --amount 0.3 --seed 5
mode object
select all
shade flat
export hill.glb
